correctness.rationale: Explicit 30-transient-state Markov backward system matches defined parent-weight / incident-hyperedge full copying. Neutral harmonic weights 1/d_v yield singleton 1/15,2/15,4/15,4/15,4/15. The exact rational solutions at r=3/2 and 2 and derivative system A(1)f’=b’−A’f reproduce slope gap 10/993 and opposite benchmark gaps; finite absorbing chain is nonsingular since all mixed states reach all-mutant state with positive probability. An independent small exact Fraction chain was constructed and evaluated at those parameters, not merely trusting saved logs. Analytic continuity proves a crossing but neither uniqueness nor all-r sign.

value.rationale: An explicit minimal-scale mixed-size group-interaction population exhibits a fitness-dependent amplifier/suppressor reversal that ordinary graph updating cannot model. The exact weak-selection and strong-selection rational inequalities are independently useful witnesses; no unproven global minimality is needed.

scientific_limitations: One five-site mixed-size hypergraph only; crossing existence on (3/2,2), not uniqueness or entire r interval; no biological predictive evidence.
